parameters.name: iodef
parameters.description: The contact mail address

parameters.name: iodef_critical
parameters.description: Boolean if sending report is required/critical

parameters.name: issue
parameters.description: List of CAs which are allowed to issue certificates for the domain

parameters.name: issue_critical
parameters.description: Boolean if issue is required/critical

parameters.name: issuewild
parameters.description: Allowed CAs which can issue wildcard certificates for this domain

parameters.name: issuewild_critical
parameters.description: Boolean if issuewild is required/critical

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The DMARC version, by default DMARC1

parameters.name: policy
parameters.description: The DMARC policy (p=), must be one of 'none', 'quarantine', 'reject'

parameters.name: subdomain_policy
parameters.description: The DMARC policy for subdomains (sp=), must be one of 'none', 'quarantine', 'reject'

parameters.name: alignment_spf
parameters.description: 'strict'/'s' or 'relaxed'/'r' alignment for SPF (aspf=, default: 'r')

parameters.name: alignment_dkim
parameters.description: 'strict'/'s' or 'relaxed'/'r' alignment for DKIM (adkim=, default: 'r')

parameters.name: percent
parameters.description: Number between 0 and 100, percentage for which policies are applied (pct=, default: 100)

parameters.name: rua
parameters.description: Array of aggregate report targets

parameters.name: ruf
parameters.description: Array of failure report targets

parameters.name: failure_options
parameters.description: String containing is passed raw (fo=, default: '0')

parameters.name: failure_format
parameters.description: Format in which failure reports are requested (rf=, default: 'afrf')

parameters.name: report_interval
parameters.description: Interval in which reports are requested (ri=)

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain to build the SPF record for

parameters.name: overflow
parameters.description: Overflow value

parameters.name: txt_max_size
parameters.description: TXT max size

parameters.name: domain_on_record_key
parameters.description: Whether to include the TLD on the record key

parameters.name: parts
parameters.description: SPF parts

parameters.name: flatten
parameters.description: A list of domains to flatten
